hints.content: A dilation by a scale factor of $\dfrac{1}{5}$ will map $C'$ to a point $\dfrac{1}{5}$ as far from the origin as point $C$ was, but in the same direction.

Point $C$ is $\purpleC{5}$ units left and $\maroonD{5}$ units up from the origin.

The image $C'$ will be $\dfrac{1}{5}(\purpleC{5})=1$ unit left and $\dfrac{1}{5}(\maroonD{5})=1$ unit up from the origin.
